ssh-keygen -p -f remote-key

chmod 600 remote-key          # Private key should only be readable by you
chmod 655 remote-key.pub      # Public key can be world-readable






ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -f remote-key
chmod 600 remote-key          # Private key should only be readable by you
chmod 655 remote-key.pub      # Public key can be world-readable


ssh -i /tmp/ansible/remote-key root@client1_remote

ssh -i /tmp/ansible/remote-key root@client2_remote



ansible-playbook -i inven.ini play.yml 

ansible -m ping dev -i inven.ini 

ansible -m ping web -i inven.ini
